messages.subject: legend-ggplot2
parts:
Hi, 


With the code below I produced to regression lines, one is solid and the other is broken. Now I want to add two small legend lines of the same type 
with a description next to them. I wold like for these line to be somewhere within the plot. 


Can someone please help me?

Thank you very much

Nicholas






   genesone = data.frame(cbind(human_gene_gc,human_ds_gene))
   genestwo = data.frame(cbind(human_gene_gc,human_dn_pseudo))

   
ploth<-  ggplot() +

   geom_point(data=genesone,aes(human_gene_gc,human_ds_gene),color="#404040",alpha=0)+  
   geom_smooth(aes(human_gene_gc,human_ds_gene),colour="#000000", lwd=0.4, method=lm, formula = y ~ x + I(x ^2), se=TRUE) + 

  
  geom_point(data=genestwo,aes(human_gene_gc,human_ds_pseudo), colour="#404040",alpha=0) +
  geom_smooth(aes(human_gene_gc,human_ds_pseudo),colour="#404040",lwd=0.4, lty=2, method=loess, formula = y ~ x, se=TRUE)+ 
  
  

  ggtitle("human") +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("") +
   
 
   theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank())
